attchmntText: Ambika Cotton Mills Limited has informed the Exchange -  Filing of Unaudited Financial Results & Limited Review Report for the Quarter and Six months  ended 30.09.2026   Error in extracting previous year quarter i.e Sep 2025 figures- Error rectified and filed-  RegWe draw your kind attention that in filing of unaudited financial results for the Quarter/Six months ended 30th September 2026 error kept in extracting figures relating to the quarter ended 30.09.2025 (relevant previous year quarter). The error is 30.06.2025 figures extracted instead of 30.09.2025 and the error is rectified and filed. There is no error in current year figures and filing of revised xbrl does not arise.
voiceSummary: Ambika Cotton Mills Limited filed unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30.09.2026. The company corrected an error in the previous year's quarter figures, replacing 30.06.2025 data with 30.09.2025 data. For the half year ended 30.09.2026, revenue from operations was Rs. 52290 lakhs, compared to Rs. 39162 lakhs in the previous period. Total income stood at Rs. 52923 lakhs. Profit before tax was Rs. 7041 lakhs, up from Rs. 4292 lakhs. Net profit was Rs. 5258 lakhs, compared to Rs. 3186 lakhs previously. Earnings per share was Rs. 91.84, up from Rs. 55.66. The results were reviewed by statutory auditors S. Krishnamoorthy & Co. and approved by the Board of Directors on 11th November 2026.

attchmntText: Ambika Cotton Mills Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Ambika Cotton Mills Limited reported unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026. The Board of Directors approved the results during a meeting held on 11 November 2026. For the quarter ended 30 September 2026, the company reported a net profit of Rs. 2688 lakhs, compared to Rs. 1592 lakhs in the same period last year. Earnings per share stood at Rs. 46.95. For the half year ended 30 September 2026, net profit was Rs. 5258 lakhs, compared to Rs. 3186 lakhs in the previous year. EPS was Rs. 91.84. Total income for the quarter was Rs. 24799 lakhs. The statutory auditors, S. Krishnamoorthy & Co., conducted a limited review and reported no material misstatements. The company operates in the textiles segment with no subsidiaries.
